_readme: This file is BOTH your settings file AND your backup vault.
When the app tells you a backup is due, it hands you a complete replacement
for this file. Open this file's edit page on GitHub, select all, paste, commit.
Every backup then lives in git history with a full diff - a decision ledger
that is versioned, timestamped, and effectively permanent.
A fresh device that loads the app will auto-restore from backup.decisions below.
_configEditUrl_help: Leave blank on first deploy - the app asks you for it on first load and writes it here on your next backup. Format: https://github.com/USER/REPO/edit/main/config.json (change 'main' to 'gh-pages' if that is your Pages branch).

_settings_help.defaultConfidence: Pre-filled confidence slider value (0-100) for new entries.
_settings_help.minSampleForInsight: Minimum n before the insights engine will report a pattern. Raise it to 15+ once you have a few hundred records to cut false positives.
_settings_help.nightHours: [start, end] hours counted as 'night' for the time-of-day analysis. Decisions made in this window get flagged separately.

_domains_help: Your decision categories. Keep this list SHORT and STABLE - changing it later fragments your historical comparisons. 5-8 is the sweet spot.
_stateFlags_help: Conditions you were in when deciding. These are the highest-value field in the whole schema: they are what eventually PROVE whether fatigue or time pressure is costing you decisions, rather than you merely suspecting it.
_backupPolicy_help: soft* triggers a dismissable banner. hard* BLOCKS further logging until you confirm a backup. Set hardDecisions/hardDays higher if you find it nagging, lower if you value the data more than the convenience.
